# Winged Eyeliner Stamp: The Flick Stick by Lovoir

## Create a Defined Wing in Seconds

Line up the stamp from the outer corner of your eye to the end of your eyebrow. The curved design shapes a natural cat-eye flick on each side, so matching wings come together quickly.

## Stamp for Wings, Tip for Precision

Each pen has a stamp on one end and a fine tip on the other. Use the stamp to set your wing, then define the rest of your lash line with control. You can also use the liner's 10mm width as a stencil for bolder looks.

## Long-Wear Formula Without the Dipping

The liquid lives inside the pen, so you skip the messy brush and pot. Its smooth formula applies with consistent color from start to finish. Candelilla and carnauba waxes help it dry quickly and hold up to a full day, a workout, or a night out, keeping your eyes free of panda eyes. When it's time to remove your makeup, a favorite eye makeup remover or facial cleansing oil clears it in seconds.

## Two Pens, Endless Looks

Your set includes two Classic Cocoa Brown wingliner pens, so you're ready for everyday wear and special occasions alike.

Add the Flick Stick to your beauty routine today. It's backed by a satisfaction guarantee, so you can try it with confidence.
